title: How much of your brain do you use?

probes.question: True or false: people use only about 10% of their brains.

sources.title: Ten percent of the brain myth (Wikipedia)

image.alt: Antique hand-painted anatomical illustration of a human head cut in half to show the brain, brainstem and skull.

body.question: How much of your brain do you use?
options: Virtually all of it, at different times
body.reveal: The idea that we use only 10% of our brains is a myth. Brain imaging shows activity throughout the brain, and damage almost anywhere has some effect.
